about: The single source for the site's About section (#1985). Every fact names where it comes from. 'placeholders' lists what no public source states; the site never renders them. To add one, give it a value and a source and move it to 'facts'.
name: Matias Miguez

facts.label: On this project
facts.value: Builds and maintains Notaire. In its AI SDLC he is the Owner: he approves the specifications and, as code owner, merges the changes.

facts.label: Where Notaire began
facts.value: A 2012 course project in the Licenciatura en Sistemas at Universidad FASTA, San Carlos de Bariloche, written with Juan Carlos Ramos and Estefanía Klein.
